Grizzly_Small_Rounded_Ears.description: Small, rounded ears protrude gently from the head, their subtle design enhancing the creature's perception and resilience, allowing it to remain vigilant and robust in the harshest environments.

Polar_Bear_Short_Insulated_Ears.description: These short, insulated ears are adapted to the harsh, icy landscapes, enhancing the polar bear's constitution and perception, allowing it to resist the biting cold and remain keenly alert to its surroundings.

Black_Bear_Alert_Pointed_Ears.description: Bristling with a keen sense of survival, the pointed ears of the black bear are not just vestigial appendages but powerful organs of perception, honed to detect the slightest movements and whispers of danger in the dense underbrush, their heightened agility allowing them to react with unparalleled swiftness.

Panda_Prominent_Round_Ears.description: Prominent round ears, soft and adorned with a faint sheen, twitch with heightened perception, enhancing the wearer's charisma and charm, making them irresistibly appealing and keenly aware of their surroundings.

Sun_Bear_Small_Round_Ears.description: With small, round ears that twitch with uncanny sensitivity, the Sun_Bear_Small_Round_Ears component enhances the bear's keen perception and nimble dexterity, allowing it to remain ever vigilant and agile in the dense undergrowth of the forest.

Sloth_Bear_Tufted_Floppy_Ears.description: Adorned with tufts of soft, floppy ears, this sloth bear's cephalon not only enhances its keen senses and perception, but also lends an endearing charm that can captivate the hearts of friend and foe alike.

Spectacled_Bear_Alert_Ears.description: The Spectacled_Bear_Alert_Ears component endows the beholder with oversized, highly sensitive ears, finely tuned to detect the slightest rustle or whisper, enhancing their perception and stealth, allowing them to move silently and sense danger before it arrives.

Cave_Bear_Tiny_Thick_Ears.description: Tiny yet robust ears, covered in thick fur, twitch with heightened perception, granting the cave bear an innate resilience to the chill and a keen awareness of its surroundings.

Zombie_Bear_Torn_Ears.description: Torn and ragged, the zombie bear's ears flap lifelessly from its head, the once-sensitive organs now twisted into a conduit of corruption, enhancing the beast's malevolent presence while dulling its already dim senses, making it a formidable and unpredictable adversary in the blighted forests.

Spirit_Bear_Ghostly_Ears.description: Emerging from the spectral mist, the Spirit_Bear_Ghostly_Ears manifests as a pair of translucent, ghostly ears, pulsating with a faint aura of arcane energy, enhancing the wearer's wisdom and perception, and granting them the uncanny ability to detect magic and remain perpetually alert to the unseen dangers of the spirit world.
